supersedes: single-lane bootstrap mode (no parallel policy; implicit max_parallel=1)

concurrency.oracle_policy: reuse freed slot; never a 4th concurrent agent; read-only review scope
concurrency.provider_concurrency_limit: empirical: verified by 3-parallel dry-run 2026-10-20 (result recorded in BOOTSTRAP_REVIEW.md)
concurrency.rate_limit_backoff: on provider 429/5xx: supervisor pauses new dispatch 120s, retries once, then downgrades lane to sequential

W-DATA.name: Data/Teacher
read_scopes: data/** 但显式排除 data/ground_truth/**（R1：真值仅经 pes2ts_core.g0.truth.truth_reader accessor，G0 校验 truth_access_log）
forbidden: data/ground_truth/** 任何直接读取（须走 truth_reader）
W-DATA.never_write_note: config/campaigns/v5_*.yaml 逐文件列出 = 旧协议冻结件只读

W-LOSS.name: Loss/Training
forbidden: config/campaigns/** writes (protocol freeze is E0, human-signed)

shared_files.scripts/agent_ops/__init__.py: supervisor-owned（lane 可建占位，合并时取 supervisor 版）

merge_flow.pre_merge_check: git diff --name-only 逐 lane 校验 ⊆ write_scopes（shared_files 除外）；违例即拒并
merge_flow.gate_binding: merge commit sha 写入对应 state/gates/G#.json 或 phase 记录

driver_campaign_root_rule: 复用驱动（run_v5_1_sprint/r1_gradient_probe 等）默认输出根指向 sealed 目录（v5_1/v5_1_r1）——30h 战役一律显式覆盖为 outputs/pesn/30h_campaign/**，驱动启动时断言拒绝 sealed 前缀（WP-L2 实现于 runner）
gate_rule: gates evaluated strictly in DAG order by supervisor; no downstream lane starts formal (non-fixture) execution on a failed/blocked upstream gate; fixture-level test-scaffolding work may proceed in parallel but its results are marked not_admissible_until_gate_pass

gpu.mutex: /tmp/opencode/pes2ts_gpu.lock (flock；**一切 CUDA 进程**持有：正式训练/评测、E0 吞吐 smoke、lane CUDA 测试；holder 元数据含 pid/lane/run_id)
gpu.precheck: 派发前 nvidia-smi 校验无外部占用（当前 2.6GB 占用须先查明归属，禁盲杀——PD-8）
during_training_parallel_cpu_work: V5.2 head development behind frozen interface
gpu.frozen_version_rule: while a formal run is active, no lane may modify files hash-pinned in that run's config_sha256 set; supervisor enforces via ledger pre-write check

fix_policy.cross_module: oracle read-only review first; then re-dispatch to one owner lane

agent_report_schema.raw_logs: forbidden in report; cite paths under worktree / logs dir only

on_interrupt: check running processes (pgrep patterns per lane)
only then re-dispatch; duplicate run_id submission forbidden
resume_policy.ledger: run_plan.jsonl（E0 规划件，supervisor 专属，防止规划 run 被误计完成）与 run_records.jsonl（执行账本，append-only，run_id unique）分离；ledger 仅索引终态记录；成本账含失败/重试
resume_policy.run_id_key: campaign_id+phase+arm+fold+seed+config/data/teacher/feature/split sha 前缀；attempt/parent_run_id 字段追踪重试；66/33 上限计所有 launch attempt
resume_policy.deadline: E0 写死 campaign 起止绝对时间；phase 级 deadline_utc 超时自动 blocked；剩余预算不足任务预估即拒派

launch_guard.token_rule: formal_training_authorized 仅授权 30h 正式训练；sealed/Confirm/OOD 解封与 Fit150+ 是**独立审批 token**，本战役恒为 false（ADR-0029 §2.4、30h §7.3），任何阶段不得由该开关连带打开
launch_guard.requires: user explicit confirmation after BOOTSTRAP_REVIEW.md dry-run section signed
sealed_boundaries: old 53-run evidence = outputs/pesn/v5_1 (21 runs) + v5_1_r1 (32 runs), per ADR-0028 §2.4
hard_no: modifying frozen 30h protocol after E0 sign-off
